Answer: Race condition in the control task
Detail: The bug occurred when a fast-fingered operator corrected an input error in less than eight seconds. This specific timing caused the software to "lose track" of the hardware state, firing a high-power electron beam without the heavy tungsten target in place to convert it to safe X-rays.
